summary: Valley of Trials 1-6, Sen'jin and Razor Hill 6-10, northern Durotar 10-12, then the Barrens.

tips.general: Take the quest and run straight to the Den. Kill boars on the way.

steps.objectiveText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.
Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

tips.speed: Speedrun: pick up every Valley quest before leaving the Den, and do not hand anything in until the boars, apples and weapons are all done.

steps.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

tips.general: Forever quest. The Abandoned Training Weapons lie on the ground around the Valley; pick them up while you kill boars.

steps.objectiveText: Collect 6 Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.

tips.general: Do Cutting Teeth, Wayward Weapons and the cactus apples in the same loop around the Valley.

steps.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.
Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

tips.general: Forever lets orcs be mages. Gornek gives orc mages this class letter for the mage trainer in the Den, like the other class letters.

steps.objectiveText: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.

tips.general: Forever lets trolls be warlocks. Troll warlocks get this class letter for Nartok, the warlock trainer in the Den.

steps.objectiveText: Read the Tainted Tablet and speak to Nartok inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.

tips.general: Hand it to the mage trainer in the Den.

steps.objectiveText: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
Read the Tainted Tablet and speak to Nartok inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.

tips.general: Cactus Apples grow at the base of the cacti across the Valley. Pick them up between kills.

steps.objectiveText: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.
Collect 6 Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.

professionHooks.text: Forever change: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise now lets you pick a gathering starter book (Mining for Dummies, Wild Harvest or Pelt Collecting for Beginners) as well as the Cactus Apple Surprise recipe. Pick the one for your planned gathering profession.

steps.objectiveText: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.
Get 10 Scorpid Worker Tails for Gornek in the Den.

class.Warlock: Warlocks get their own Vile Familiars quest from Ruzan (1485) instead.

steps.objectiveText: Kill 12 Vile Familiars.

tips.general: Warlocks: Ruzan gives you your own Vile Familiars quest (6 Vile Familiar Heads) instead of the one from Zureetha.

steps.objectiveText: Bring 6 Vile Familiar Heads to Ruzan.

tips.general: Use the Blackjack on sleeping peons as you pass them; you do not need to go out of your way.

steps.objectiveText: Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.
Kill Sarkoth and bring his claw back to Hana'zua.

tips.general: Scorpids are north of the Den. Kill them on the way to Hana'za and Sarkoth.

professionHooks.text: Keep every Scorpid Stinger. Grimtak, the Razor Hill butcher, sells Recipe: Scorpid Surprise; cook the stingers there for early Cooking skill and free food.

steps.objectiveText: Get 10 Scorpid Worker Tails for Gornek in the Den.

tips.general: Sarkoth is a lone level 4 scorpid in the gully north-west of Hana'zua. Pull him away from the other scorpids.

steps.objectiveText: Kill Sarkoth and bring his claw back to Hana'zua.
Kill Sarkoth and bring his claw back to Hana'zua.
Bring the news of Hana'zua's plight to Gornek at the Den.

tips.general: Familiars are north of the Den, in front of the Burning Blade cave. Pull two at a time if your class is strong at level 4 (warrior, hunter).

steps.objectiveText: Kill 12 Vile Familiars.

tips.general: Same familiars, in front of the Burning Blade cave.

steps.objectiveText: Bring 6 Vile Familiar Heads to Ruzan.
Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.
Kill 12 Vile Familiars.
Bring 6 Vile Familiar Heads to Ruzan.

tips.general: Ruzan then sends you to Zureetha, who gives you Burning Blade Medallion.

steps.objectiveText: Speak with Zureetha Fargaze.
Speak with Zureetha Fargaze.
Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.
Use the Foreman's Blackjack on Lazy Peons when they're sleeping. Wake up 5 peons, then return the Foreman's Blackjack to Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials.
Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.

tips.general: Yarrog Baneshadow is at the back of the Burning Blade cave. Thazz'ril's Pick lies inside the same cave, so get both in one run.
tips.tank: Pull the cultists in the cave one at a time; they hit hard for level 5.
tips.healer: Stop and drink between pulls in the cave.
tips.dps: Kill Yarrog quickly; he is a caster, so fight him in melee range or interrupt him.

steps.objectiveText: Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.
Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.
Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.
Bring the news of Hana'zua's plight to Gornek at the Den.
Get 10 Scorpid Worker Tails for Gornek in the Den.

tips.speed: Speedrun: leave the Valley at 5-6 even if not every quest is done; Sen'jin quests give more XP per minute.

steps.objectiveText: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

profTips.text: Forever: each creature can only be skinned once, so skin your own kills right away before someone else does.
Forever: every profession gets a camp object at skill 20. Push your professions to 20 early to unlock it.
Forever: crafting items to sell to vendors no longer pays (vendor prices were cut on 16 Oct). Craft for skill-ups, your own gear and other players.
Forever: healing potions are made with First Aid now, so keep your Linen Cloth for First Aid.
Forever: starter-zone Herbalism and Skinning trainers teach only the first rank. Train the next rank in your capital.

tips.general: Train level 6 spells at your class trainer in the Valley before you leave.
Ukor waits on the road east out of the Valley. His quest ends at the Razor Hill inn, so you can turn it in when you get there.

steps.objectiveText: Bring Ukor's Burden to Innkeeper Grosk in Razor Hill.
Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
Bring 4 Intact Makrura Eyes and 8 vials of Crawler Mucus to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
Bring 4 Durotar Tiger Furs to Vel'rin Fang in Sen'jin Village.

tips.general: Forever quest from Vel'rin Fang. The Ridgeshade spiders are on the way north to Razor Hill, so it costs almost no extra time.

steps.objectiveText: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
Lar Prowltusk outside of Sen'jin Village wants you to destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Kolkar Crag.
Retrieve Minshina's skull from the circle of power on the Echo Isles.

tips.general: Take Zalazane now so it is in your log when you reach the Echo Isles at 10-11.

steps.objectiveText: Defeat Zalazane.
Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.

tips.general: Needs Luminous Residue, which you get by disenchanting Hexed Pendants from Echo Isles trolls. Only take it if you or a friend has Enchanting.

steps.objectiveText: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
Speak with Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.

tips.general: Makrura and crawlers line the coast north of Sen'jin. Kill both on the same walk up the beach.

steps.objectiveText: Bring 4 Intact Makrura Eyes and 8 vials of Crawler Mucus to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.

tips.general: The three sets of Attack Plans are on the ground inside Kolkar Crag. Stay on the edge of the camp and kill only the centaurs that stand between you and the plans.

steps.objectiveText: Lar Prowltusk outside of Sen'jin Village wants you to destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Kolkar Crag.

tips.general: Pal'juh is held inside Kolkar Crag; talk to him to start the escort.

steps.objectiveText: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.

tips.general: Forever escort from Kolkar Crag. Free Pal'juh while you are in the camp; the turn-in is Master Vornal in Sen'jin.

steps.objectiveText: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
Bring 4 Intact Makrura Eyes and 8 vials of Crawler Mucus to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
Lar Prowltusk outside of Sen'jin Village wants you to destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Kolkar Crag.

tips.general: Kill Ridgeshade Creepers and Lurkers in the ridge between Sen'jin and Razor Hill as you walk north.

steps.objectiveText: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.

tips.general: Run north to Razor Hill. On the way, kill Durotar Tigers for Practical Prey when you see them.

steps.objectiveText: Bring Ukor's Burden to Innkeeper Grosk in Razor Hill.
Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.

tips.speed: Speedrun: hearth is your shortcut back from the Echo Isles at 11-12, so set it here.
tips.general: Set your hearth in Razor Hill. Every remaining Durotar quest ends near here.

steps.objectiveText: Speak with Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
Bring Fizzle's Claw to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.

tips.general: Forever chain from Orgnil: Heglan Shadeeye is just north of Tiragarde Keep, so do it on the keep trip.

steps.objectiveText: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
Kill 10 Kul Tiras Sailors, 8 Kul Tiras Marines and Lieutenant Benedict and return to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
Furl Scornbrow in the Razor Hill watchtower wants 8 Canvas Scraps.

professionHooks.text: Keep every Scorpid Stinger. Grimtak, the Razor Hill butcher, sells Recipe: Scorpid Surprise; cook the stingers there for early Cooking skill and free food.

steps.objectiveText: Bring 3 Taillasher Eggs to Cook Torka in Razor Hill.

tips.general: Forever quest from Turroc in Razor Hill. The three raider items are at the edge of Tiragarde Keep, so it fits the keep run.

steps.objectiveText: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.
Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
Kill 4 Razormane Quilboars, 4 Razormane Scouts, 4 Razormane Dustrunners and 4 Razormane Battleguards for Gar'Thok at Razor Hill.
Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
Find signs of what attacked Heglan Shadeeye.

tips.general: The dagger, banner scrap and trident piece lie on the ground around Heglan.

steps.objectiveText: Find signs of what attacked Heglan Shadeeye.

tips.general: Tiragarde Keep: clear the sailors outside first, then work up the keep for the marines. Lieutenant Benedict is on the top floor. Loot the key he drops: it opens his chest, which starts The Admiral's Orders.
tips.tank: The marines come in pairs. Fight with your back to a wall so they cannot surround you.
tips.healer: Pull the sailors one at a time; skip marines you do not need.
tips.dps: Benedict has a guard by him. Kill the guard first, then Benedict.

steps.objectiveText: Kill 10 Kul Tiras Sailors, 8 Kul Tiras Marines and Lieutenant Benedict and return to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.

tips.general: Open Benedict's chest on the top floor of the keep with his key. The Aged Envelope inside starts this quest.

steps.objectiveText: Take Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.

tips.general: Canvas Scraps drop from the sailors and marines you are already killing.

steps.objectiveText: Furl Scornbrow in the Razor Hill watchtower wants 8 Canvas Scraps.
Kill 10 Kul Tiras Sailors, 8 Kul Tiras Marines and Lieutenant Benedict and return to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
Find signs of what attacked Heglan Shadeeye.
Take Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
Deliver Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Nazgrel in Thrall's chamber in Orgrimmar.
Furl Scornbrow in the Razor Hill watchtower wants 8 Canvas Scraps.

tips.general: Hand in to Turroc in Razor Hill.

steps.objectiveText: Collect the Raider's Battleaxe, Raider's Bow, and Raider's Shield from the Tiragarde Keep outskirts, then return them to Turroc in Razor Hill.

tips.general: The wreckage is in the water east of Razor Hill. Gnomish Tools are inside crates on the sea floor; watch your breath.

steps.objectiveText: Gar'Thok of Razor Hill wants you to retrieve 3 Gnomish Tools from the wreckage off the coast.
Gar'Thok of Razor Hill wants you to retrieve 3 Gnomish Tools from the wreckage off the coast.
Gar'Thok of Razor Hill wants you to retrieve 3 Gnomish Tools from the wreckage off the coast.

tips.general: Level 10: go to your class trainer for your level 10 spells and class quest (Hunter pet quest, Warrior Veteran Uzzek, Shaman Call of Fire, Warlock Gan'rul's Summons and so on).
Razormane quilboar are west of Razor Hill. Get all four kinds, then return. Do the prickly pears in the same area if you took that quest.

steps.objectiveText: Kill 4 Razormane Quilboars, 4 Razormane Scouts, 4 Razormane Dustrunners and 4 Razormane Battleguards for Gar'Thok at Razor Hill.

tips.general: Tigers are thickest in southern Durotar around Sen'jin (see map pins). Finish the furs on the run back south.

steps.objectiveText: Bring 4 Durotar Tiger Furs to Vel'rin Fang in Sen'jin Village.
Kill 4 Razormane Quilboars, 4 Razormane Scouts, 4 Razormane Dustrunners and 4 Razormane Battleguards for Gar'Thok at Razor Hill.

tips.general: The Prickly Pear Fruit is in the Razormane Grounds west of Razor Hill, where you just killed quilboar.

steps.objectiveText: Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.
Cook Torka in Razor Hill wants you to collect 8 Prickly Pear Fruit from the Razormane Grounds west of town.

tips.general: Run back south to Sen'jin with Practical Prey and Minshina's Skull ready to finish.
Swim over from Sen'jin; Minshina's Skull sits inside the ring of power on the Echo Isles.

steps.objectiveText: Retrieve Minshina's skull from the circle of power on the Echo Isles.

tips.general: Zalazane is a caster on the Echo Isles surrounded by hexed trolls. Clear the trolls around him first, then fight him alone.
tips.tank: Pull the guards one at a time, then take Zalazane with interrupts ready.
tips.healer: Group with someone if you can; solo, kill him slowly and keep your mana for heals.
tips.dps: Burst him down. If you are a melee class, use your stun when his health gets low so he cannot heal.

steps.objectiveText: Defeat Zalazane.

tips.general: The Taillasher Eggs sit in raptor nests on the south-east coast near the Echo Isles. Grab them while you are down here.

steps.objectiveText: Bring 3 Taillasher Eggs to Cook Torka in Razor Hill.
Bring 4 Durotar Tiger Furs to Vel'rin Fang in Sen'jin Village.

tips.general: The idols are on the Echo Isles; collect them while you are there for Zalazane.

steps.objectiveText: Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

tips.general: Kill the Bloodtalon Matriarch (level 9) for her eggs; raptors are along the south-east coast.

steps.objectiveText: Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.

tips.general: Disenchant Hexed Pendants from Echo Isles trolls into Luminous Residue.

steps.objectiveText: Pa'zula in Sen'jin Village wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Hexed Pendants dropped by trolls in the Echo Isles.
Collect 8 Forgotten Loa Idols from the Echo Isles. Bring them to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
Bring Eggs of the Bloodtalon Matriarch to Xar'Ti in Sen'jin Village.

tips.general: Hand in to Pa'zula in Sen'jin.

Retrieve Minshina's skull from the circle of power on the Echo Isles.
Defeat Zalazane.

tips.general: Hearth back to Razor Hill.

steps.objectiveText: Bring 3 Taillasher Eggs to Cook Torka in Razor Hill.

tips.speed: Speedrun: if you are already 12, skip Skull Rock and head to the Barrens; you lose little XP.
tips.general: Conscript of the Horde from Takrin Pathseeker sends you to the Barrens. Take it now and turn it in when you leave Durotar.

steps.objectiveText: Follow the western road from Razor Hill to the Barrens over a bridge.

tips.general: Rhinag is by the road to Orgrimmar. Need for a Cure sends you to Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar for the antidote; do it on the same Orgrimmar visit as The Admiral's Orders.

steps.objectiveText: Find Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar and get the Venomtail Antidote. Then bring the antidote to Rhinag near the northwestern border of Durotar.
Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and return them to Rezlak near Orgrimmar.

tips.general: Fizzle Darkstorm is in Thunder Ridge. He is a caster standing among the thunder lizards; clear the lizards near him first and interrupt his casts if you can.

steps.objectiveText: Bring Fizzle's Claw to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.

tips.general: The Sacks of Supplies lie in Drygulch Ravine among the harpies.

steps.objectiveText: Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and return them to Rezlak near Orgrimmar.
Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and return them to Rezlak near Orgrimmar.
Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.

tips.general: Savages and storm witches in Drygulch Ravine. Storm witches use lightning; interrupt them or kill them first.

steps.objectiveText: Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.

tips.general: A Simmering Storm starts from the Dull Storm Orb, which drops from Dustwind Storm Witches and Eggtenders at Drygulch Ravine; it unlocks Stormy Potential from Rezlak.

steps.objectiveText: Bring the Dull Stormy Orb to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.
Bring the Dull Stormy Orb to Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.

tips.general: Forever quest. Charged Thunder Lizard Organs come from the thunder lizards in Thunder Ridge; kill them as you go for Fizzle.

tips.general: Kron's Amulet drops from the Dreadmaw Crocolisks along the river west of the farmstead.

Kor'ghan is in the Drag. He needs Venomtail Poison Sacs before he makes the antidote.

Deliver Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Nazgrel in Thrall's chamber in Orgrimmar.

tips.general: Thrall's Hidden Enemies: the Lieutenant's Insignia drops from the Burning Blade in Skull Rock, so it fits the Skull Rock trip.

steps.objectiveText: Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

tips.general: Get the Orgrimmar flight path from Doras on the tower.
Venomtail Scorpids roam northern Durotar between Orgrimmar and Thunder Ridge.

Bring 4 Venomtail Poison Sacs to Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar.

tips.general: The next part sends you into Ragefire Chasm (Bazzalan and Jergosh the Invoker). Take it only with dungeons on; run it with a group at 14-16.

steps.noDungeonAlt: Skip it; with dungeons off the Barrens quests carry you to 20 with no gap.
